approaches_tried.reason: orchestrate-predispatch-review.sh runs set -euo pipefail; the library's read -r -d '' <<'JQDEFS' heredoc idiom always returns non-zero at EOF, which aborts the whole script under -e the instant it is sourced outside a tested if-condition. Fixed by copying orchestrate-batch-admit.sh's `if ! . ...; then error; fi` idiom instead.

approaches_tried.approach: apostrophes (possessive 's) inside the new Class F/G jq-block bash comments
approaches_tried.reason: the jq program is embedded in a bash single-quoted string; a literal apostrophe inside a comment prematurely closes that string at the bash parse level, producing a bash syntax error a few lines later. Rewrote both comments to avoid all apostrophes, matching the existing apostrophe-free convention already used in the pre-existing Class A/B comments.

deviations.description: Add a Class G generator using is_glob_entry, splicing FILE_SCOPE_OVERLAP_JQ_DEFS (the script already splices it for Classes C/D/E per the plan)
deviations.reason: The plan/research premise that orchestrate-predispatch-review.sh already splices FILE_SCOPE_OVERLAP_JQ_DEFS is false (confirmed by grep: 0 occurrences before this phase). Classes C/D/E consume orchestrate-batch-admit.sh subprocess verdicts, never the jq defs directly. Added new sourcing instead of reusing an existing splice; see Phase 1's handoff for the original discovery.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — added NEW sourcing rather than reusing an existing splice, plus the -euo pipefail-safe if-wrapped idiom and an apostrophe-free comment rewrite)*
